thesis: Philosophies assign beauty different functions: intelligible order, education of desire, refuge, or affirmation amid suffering.

ideas.statement: Beauty may interrupt instrumental desire or intensify life without proving the world good or true.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The picturesque impoverished city illustrates the difference between a harmonious total view and intolerable conditions within it; metaphysical readings are not empirical demonstrations.
